customer.business: RizqPure Halal Collagen (UK online supplement brand)

behaviours.name: Strict halal checker

behaviours.name: Beauty and skincare enthusiast
behaviours.how: Follows Muslim beauty creators on TikTok and Instagram and tries what they recommend.

behaviours.name: Sceptical label reader
behaviours.how: Wants evidence that a supplement works before paying for it monthly.

behaviours.name: Deal hunter
behaviours.how: Buys supplements on Amazon or at Holland & Barrett when they are on offer.

behaviours.name: Already uses a non-halal collagen

behaviours.name: Values-driven buyer

behaviours.name: Family-first spender
behaviours.how: Puts the household budget first and feels guilty spending on themselves.

pitch:
RizqPure Halal Collagen: a 300g pouch of unflavoured grass-fed bovine collagen peptides with vitamin C and biotin, 30 daily servings (one scoop in tea, coffee, a smoothie or water).
The cattle are halal-slaughtered and the product is halal-certified. Sold online at rizqpure.com.
£18 for one pouch, or £14.40 a month on Subscribe & Save (20% off, cancel any time). Free UK delivery on orders over £30. 30-day hassle-free returns.
Part of every sale pays for meals for families in need. The site shows 4.8/5 from 320+ reviews.
